name: qf-p2lba-ogrant-5b059065b-tc-hm10-lvt
purpose: p2lba 2026-10-11 (mtp-colllane-1011): dsfd_coll_p2_lane_ba at origin/main 5b059065b = the OGRANT structural fix (8aa62270c: received words land in a 4-word register FIFO whose REGISTERED room gates the landing; output = MTP grant sender ot_dsrom_mtp_ltx, r_r into a pin flop, r_v/r_d from flops, no pin drives an enable). Routed classes before it: 0ddaf548b TT -141 (r_r -> li_ready -> 604-bit enables, 13-15 lv); quickfix RSKID d9fbc9948 TT -49/-50 = r_r -> skid2 out_d/sk_d 604-bit enables (10-12 lv, 400 paths SS) + out_v->r_v; both classes removed by OGRANT. 8aa62270c routes crashed only because SRCS lacked rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_link_pair.sv (ot_dsrom_mtp_ltx not part of the design) -- added here; SDCM now exported. + OT_MULTI_VT=lvt (<= 2% cells) for margin. P2 gate at 5b059065b: p2l_s1 26,692 / p2l_s5 26,544 cyc (base 0ddaf548b 27,020), negatives FAIL. HM 0.010.
